commands.evidence_level: Node control and runtime integration with real LabRuntime, Rapier, AudioEngine implementation and solver frames; FakeAudioContext is not native DSP or device output.

resolved_review_findings.issue: Original enqueue event could be replaced by later logical update.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: PendingNativeVoice copies the enqueue VoiceIntent; delayed test verifies original tick 1 event while logical update and actual admission attempt are tick 3.

resolved_review_findings.issue: Logical document revision could be read at attempt after an intervening revision.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: PendingNativeVoice captures behaviorDocumentRevision at enqueue and carries it in saved pending state.

resolved_review_findings.issue: Chronology mixed logical event time and actual rejection time.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Native event row uses attemptedAtTick; audioEventTick retains original logical time; combined rows are tick-sorted.

resolved_review_findings.issue: Old rejection could be described as latest actual admission attempt.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Both locales now label retained history as latest native rejection.

reviewed_behavior: Actual playVoice accepted=false result supplies the exact reason, original audio event/instance/binding/rule/object/generation/run epoch/profile context, source and AcousticFrame request metadata.
Native rejection data is separate from BehaviorDecisionView; no evaluator reason, suppression status, physics event or captured behavior artifact is rewritten.
Recent rejection storage is bounded to 64 rows, copied on read and keyed by semantic event/instance/frame/reason identity.
ACOUSTIC_FRAME_UNAVAILABLE is recorded while its pending input remains for retry; other actual rejections keep the prior delete-pending behavior.
newBehavior, authoring drain, gravity revision, replay, stopReplay and seek clear ephemeral native history; preview execution does not append or clear original-run diagnostics.
UI exposes the rejection in event and rule diagnostics, preserves exact reason codes including unknown/prototype-named strings, and labels logical starts independently of native device output.
Primary 9-source regression explicitly injects test-only maxSources=8 into the real engine; product default budgets and evaluator maxVoices=16 are unchanged.
Prepared browser spec uses an explicitly test-only private source budget override, observes native Web Audio control metadata, and states that it is not PCM or hearing evidence.

red_evidence.result: Preserved original primary regression failure: native rejection must retain a separate inspectable event association.
red_evidence.execution: Original RED log inspected; not regenerated or changed by reviewer.

limits: Browser config/spec were inspected only; reviewer did not launch or control a browser or touch live audio processes.

Five dedicated tests directly cover SOURCE_BUDGET and AUDIO_NOT_ENABLED; the retryable ACOUSTIC_FRAME_UNAVAILABLE retention branch was reviewed statically.
Build/typecheck/full npm check, schema/protected acceptance audit, Wiki/document freshness and full V1 completion are outside this review.
Only independent-review.json was written by this reviewer; no source, docs, Wiki, Git state, audio engine files or processes were modified.
